overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional presence across decentralized and professional platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon), totaling 3,580 followers. His audience shows exceptionally high engagement with updates on computational social science research, tool releases, grant announcements, and academic hiring opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Posts discussing research methodology, tools (like CooRnet v2.0), and publications on detecting coordinated campaigns.
Announcements regarding open postdoc positions and PhD research opportunities.
Celebratory posts regarding team awards, grant wins, and upcoming conference presentations.

recommendations: Increase post frequency on Mastodon, leveraging its niche academic tech audience with deeper technical breakdowns of software updates like CooRnet.
Cross-promote engagement on LinkedIn by attaching visual assets, infographics, or link previews to publication and hiring posts to boost organic reach further.
Utilize interactive formats such as Q&A threads or polls on Bluesky to convert high repost numbers into active comment discussions.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest overall engagement rate (~6.14%) per post, with particularly strong share/repost rates for research calls and publication announcements.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche but responsive audience focused heavily on tool updates and methodological discussion, achieving solid engagement relative to audience size.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the largest absolute engagement volume (likes and comments), making it the most effective platform for major career milestones, funding announcements, and recruitment.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
